title: HardcoreSleep
description: HardcoreSleep is a plug-in for Minecraft servers based on Paper 1.20.1 that adds realistic sleep and sleep deprivation mechanics for players
body:
**HardcoreSleep is a plug-in for Minecraft servers based on Paper 1.20.1 that adds realistic sleep and sleep deprivation mechanics for players**

**What's it?**

HardcoreSleep is an innovative plugin for Minecraft that adds realistic sleep and sleep deprivation mechanics, making the gameplay more challenging and exciting. The plugin is ideal for servers aiming for a more realistic and challenging gameplay.

**Why should I install it?**

Realistic gameplay: Adds an important element of survival that forces players to plan their actions.

Unique Experience: Different from the standard Minecraft sleep mechanics

Flexible configuration: The ability to customize all parameters to meet the needs of your server

Multilingualism: Built-in support for different languages

Optimization: Efficient operation without affecting server performance

**Main functions**

1. The sleep deprivation system
Players get negative effects from prolonged sleep deprivation.
Gradual deterioration over time
Visual and sound effects for status indication
The ability to adjust the time before the effects occur

2. Improved sleep mechanics
The requirement of regular sleep to maintain health
Influence on the player's characteristics (speed, damage, defense)
Special bonuses for observing the sleep regime
Recovery system after prolonged wakefulness

3. Commands and interface
/sleep - the main command for sleep management
/sleep status - checking the current state
/sleep stats - player's sleep statistics
Informative status messages

4. Setup and integration
Fully customizable settings via the configuration file
Support for economy plugins
API for integration with other plugins
A permission system for different groups of players_

**Why HardcoreSleep?**

_Uniqueness: There are no analogues with such a detailed study of sleep mechanics.
Quality: Thoroughly tested and optimized code
Flexibility: Extensive customization options
Support: Active development and updating
